accepted_scope: On split P^1_K over every complete characteristic-zero real-valued non-Archimedean field K, every actual ample rational line bundle and continuous psh reference, every positive Radon target of raw mass deg L: all actual E1-test integrability iff finite continuous dual iff an actual E1 solution exists. Every solution is unique modulo a finite constant at every analytic point, including common poles, and is a variational maximizer. Includes trivial/nontrivial/nondiscrete/non-algebraically-closed fields and positive residue characteristic, without target support or invariance restrictions. Natural-log kernel dual identities are for the standard anchored upstairs construction; rational energy/dual scale quadratically and raw measure linearly.
residual_original_scope: No nontrivially valued higher-genus or nonsplit genus-zero curve equation, general-variety prescribed-target equation, or general compactness/envelope replacement. Separate singular/nonample/nonprojective/nonalgebraizable axes remain open.
